Codex Chrome / Browser Use allowlist issue
description: Enterprise network policy blocks access to specific domains during automated browser sessions. Blocked hosts: https://substack.cpf-coaching.com, https://vcisobriefing.substack.com, https://login.buffer.com, https://publish.buffer.com. The exact failure class is: enterprise network policy blocks it. Note that manual Chrome access works locally, but Codex browser automation does not. Workarounds are forbidden by the tool once this policy is triggered.
notes: Update June 9, 2026: The failure mode has changed. Host-level tab claiming now succeeds for both Substack and Buffer (the hard host-deny error is gone). However, actual page reads (even lightweight document.title calls) now stall and trigger a browser-kernel timeout. The read path is currently unusable.
